note: Digital landscape assessment of 21 ministries; reports weak interoperability but names no law, decree or draft on public bodies sharing data.
EDPA directive under the Data Protection Act 2022 on data mapping by controllers; a data protection instrument (class other), not a law on public bodies sharing data with each other.

Electronic Communications and Transactions Act 2022 (Act 3 of 2022) regulates e-transactions and use of e-government services; the passages held do not state that it provides for public bodies exchanging data.
